messages.content: Explain why a metal spoon feels colder than a wooden spoon when both are at room temperature. Answer in two to four sentences of plain prose.

message.content: Although both spoons are at the same room temperature, metal is a much better conductor of heat than wood. When you touch the metal spoon, it rapidly draws heat away from your hand, whereas the wooden spoon conducts heat very slowly. Because your skin loses heat quickly to the metal, your brain perceives it as being much colder.
